summary.text: Mark Paige is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 11 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Democratic primary.
He has worked as a school law attorney and as a university professor.

paragraphs.text: Mark Paige earned a B.A. in political science and government from Tufts University in 1997, a J.D. from the University of Wisconsin at Madison in 2007, and a Ph.D. from the University of Wisconsin at Madison in 2011.

His career experience includes work as an associate professor and department chair at the University of Massachusetts at Dartmouth, a school law attorney with Drummond Woodsum, and a program supervisor with the University of Wisconsin.
Paige has served on the board of directors of the Great Bay Kids Early Learning Center and the Southern District YMCA.
Ballotpedia's campaign contribution history lists general-election wins for Paige in 2020 (Rockingham 18) and in 2022 and 2024 (Rockingham 11).
He was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.
